budget_items.what_was_recorded: The levy to be raised for fiscal year 2016 was stated by the Assessors' representative.

budget_items.quote: residential, commercial, industrial and personal property at $19.62 per thousand.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The average single family home value rose from fiscal year 2015 to fiscal year 2016.
budget_items.quote: increased from $246,347 in fiscal year 2015 to $256,969 for fiscal year

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The average tax bill rose by 11.7% between fiscal years 2015 and 2016.
budget_items.quote: the average tax bill increased by 11.7% from $4,513.08 in fiscal year 2015 to $5041.73

budget_items.topic: School project debt in tax bill
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Of the average tax bill increase, 66% came from debt repayment for the middle/high school project, amounting to $349.48 on the average bill.
budget_items.quote: of this $528.65 increase, 66% results from the debt repayment for the lunenburg middle/high school project, amounting to $349.48 on the average tax bill.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town has one more borrowing to do in January 2016, expected to be the bulk of the project less contingency.
budget_items.quote: the town has one additional borrowing to do, sometime in january 2016, ranging between four and six million dollars.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Change order #5 was reported at around $8200.00, bringing the running total of change orders to $170,000 out of a 4 million dollar contingency.
budget_items.quote: total change order is around $8200.00 bringing the running total of change orders to $170,000 out of the 4 million dollar contingency

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board signed accounts payable, school construction, payroll and payroll deductions warrants.
